'conexion_humana' es el nombre humano de lo que el usuario tendría que conectar (para el copy del gate: 'disponible cuando conectes X'). 'tools_capability' = los nombres de tool que el server expone; el backend (brands.py) los corre por el enforcer de Security (platform/gates/recipe_enforcer.py) y DERIVA el campo 'gate' (money_touch|send|null) — la UI lo consume verbatim, jamás clasifica. Marcas declaradas por el catálogo, por N.en_pulido: Brands declared by the catalog, by belt server NAME. The UI consumes this verbatim and NEVER guesses. 'conexion_humana' is the human-readable name of what the user would need to connect (for the gate copy: 'available when you connect X'). 'tools_capability' = the tool names the server exposes; the backend (brands.py) runs them through the Security enforcer (platform/gates/recipe_enforcer.py) and DERIVES the 'gate' field (money_touch|send|null) — the UI consumes this verbatim, never classifies. CONFIGURABLE: adding a niche = adding its servers here; zero hardcode in the UI.

Redirect URI a registrar EXACTO en la app de Google: {PUPPET_OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE|http://localhost:8080}/v1/connectors/gmail/callback. Redirect URI to register EXACTLY in the Google app: {PUPPET_OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE|http://localhost:8080}/v1/connectors/gmail/callback. DURABILITY CAVEAT: Google only returns a refresh_token if the authorize_url includes access_type=offline&prompt=consent; build_authorize_url does not yet send these → the access_token currently lasts ~1h with no refresh. Follow-ups for a permanent connection: (a) add those params to authorize, (b) store and use the refresh_token in the broker. identity_field='email' is cosmetic: Google's token endpoint does not return email (identity will be null; does not break the flow).
